admission.calculation: 15 min setup plus twice the largest measured sum of the three modes on the same timing root; 25% timeout reserve. Twice maximum observed RSS plus 4 GB. All player counts receive this global allowance.
admission.limitation: Fresh positions may be slower than calibration. Retain failures and caps, never reduce samples, substitute roots or rerun after an observation timeout. This admits diagnostic fidelity jobs, not full-game strength or 8840U serving latency.
